title: US Startup Funding Signals — SEC Form D Input

daysBack.title: Lookback Window (Days Back)
daysBack.description: Number of calendar days back from today to scan SEC EDGAR Form D filings (e.g. 7 scans the past 7 days).

maxResults.title: Max Startup Signals Returned
maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching startup funding records to extract and return. Default prefill (15) completes in ~5-8 seconds while respecting SEC EDGAR rate limits.

minOfferingAmountUsd.title: Minimum Total Offering Amount (USD)
minOfferingAmountUsd.description: Minimum total offering size in USD (`totalOfferingAmountUsd`). Filters out micro/token filings.

minAmountSoldUsd.title: Minimum Amount Already Sold (USD)
minAmountSoldUsd.description: Minimum capital already closed/sold in USD (`totalAmountSoldUsd`). Set > 0 to exclude offerings with $0 closed so far.

excludePooledInvestmentFunds.title: Exclude Pooled Investment / VC / Hedge Funds
excludePooledInvestmentFunds.description: Key GTM Filter: Automatically removes ~70% of SEC Form D noise (Hedge Funds, Private Equity Funds, Venture Capital Funds, and 3(c)(1)/3(c)(7) pooled vehicles) so you ONLY get real operating startups!

industries.title: Target Industries (Optional Filter)
industries.description: Optional list of SEC Form D industry groups to match (case-insensitive, supports partial match e.g. 'Technology', 'Computers', 'Telecommunications', 'Biotechnology', 'Health Care'). Leave empty to return all operating industries.

states.title: Target US States / Countries (Optional Filter)
states.description: Optional list of 2-letter issuer state/country codes (e.g. ['CA', 'NY', 'TX', 'MA', 'WA', 'DE']). Leave empty for all states.

includeAmendments.title: Include Form D/A Amendments
includeAmendments.description: If enabled, includes both initial Form D filings and Form D/A amendments (follow-on closes or expanded rounds). Disable to strictly return brand-new Form D filings.

searchQuery.title: Keyword / Company Search Query (Optional)
searchQuery.description: Optional keyword, company name, or CIK filter (e.g. 'AI', 'Therapeutics', 'Robotics'). Matched strictly against Zero-PII corporate fields.
